title: Requested and Authorized Days of an Inpatient Mental Health Authorization - TRICARE Select Lines Reprocessed for Other Insurance
content:
A **TRICARE Select** outpatient line reprocessed for other health insurance whose service date is the admission date of an inpatient mental health stay is cost-shared and paid in proportion to the days the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization in Referrals and Authorizations authorized against the days it was requested for.

**Adjudication rule.** Where the service date of the reprocessed line is the admission date of an inpatient mental health stay on the enrollment and an Inpatient Mental Health Authorization starting that day was approved (whether its days are still open or have all been used) for fewer days than it was requested for, the attending share is the days authorized divided by the days requested; where an inpatient mental health stay was admitted that day and no such approved Inpatient Mental Health Authorization is on file, the attending share is zero; otherwise the attending share is one. The amount the reprocessed line is cost-shared on is the amount left after any other insurer's payment is taken off, times the attending share, rounded to the cent. What TRICARE would pay as primary payer on a reprocessed line is the allowed amount times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability, never below zero.

## Records read

- **TRICARE Select claim lines:** a posted inpatient mental health stay on the enrollment whose admission date is the line's service date.
- **Referrals and Authorizations:** the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization starting that day - its status (approved, or exhausted where all its days have been used), the days requested and the days authorized.

## Truth table

| Inpatient mental health stay admitted that day | Authorization starting that day, approved or exhausted | Authorized fewer days than requested | Attending share |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | days authorized divided by days requested |
| yes | yes | no | one |
| yes | no | - | zero |
| no | - | - | one |

## Hypothetical figures

An authorization requested for 15 days and approved for 9 gives 9 divided by 15, that is 0.6, whether its days are still open or all used: 400.00 left after the other insurer's payment is cost-shared as 240.00. An authorization approved for all 15 requested days gives one. A denied authorization, or none at all, for a stay admitted that day gives zero.
